# hiok_servicebus_namespace (Resource)

A Hiok Service Bus namespace: the isolation boundary for queues and topics.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Namespace name.

### Optional

- `broker_config` (String) Bring-your-own broker settings (JSON).
- `broker_kind` (String) pulsar for the managed broker, byo to bring your own.
- `region` (String) Primary region.
- `replica_regions` (List of String) Regions holding a replica.
- `sku` (String) standard or premium.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `service_url` (String) Broker endpoint clients connect to.
- `status` (String) Provisioning state.
